cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.24)
project(logging_demo LANGUAGES CXX)

set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 20)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
set(CMAKE_CXX_EXTENSIONS OFF)
if(CMAKE_CROSSCOMPILING)
  set(CMAKE_SKIP_RPATH ON)
  set(CMAKE_SKIP_BUILD_RPATH ON)
  set(CMAKE_SKIP_INSTALL_RPATH ON)
  set(CMAKE_BUILD_WITH_INSTALL_RPATH OFF)
endif()

# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Find IBMW (also loads IbmwHelpers.cmake: ibmw_add_module/pkg/app/etc.)
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
find_package(ibmw 0.1.0 REQUIRED)

ibmw_add_module(logger_module
  SRCS src/logger_module/logger_module.cc
)

ibmw_add_pkg(logger_module_pkg
  SRCS src/logger_module_pkg/pkg_main.cc
  MODULES logger_module)

add_executable(logging_app src/logging_app/main.cc)
target_link_libraries(logging_app PRIVATE ibmw::core::engine)

# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Copy config files to build directory
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
file(COPY ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/cfg DESTINATION ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR})

message(STATUS "")
message(STATUS "logging_demo configured successfully!")
message(STATUS "")
message(STATUS "  1. logging_app:")
message(STATUS "       Pkg:  ibmw run cfg/logger_module_pkg.yaml")
message(STATUS "       App:  ./logging_app cfg/logging_app.yaml")
